name: Yomi Alliance
source:
Join Yomi Alliance Academy and become a Starship Officer in this unique role playing Visual Novel. You are the lead character, but events won't revolve around you as the space is a huge space and you're but an ant there.

[From [url=https://bruni-multimedia.itch.io/yomi-alliance]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加入Yomi联盟学院，在这款独特的角色扮演视觉小说中成为一名星舰军官。你是主角，但事件不会围着你转，因为空间很大，而你只是那里的一只蚂蚁。

[来自[url=https://bruni-multimedia.itch.io/yomi-alliance]Itch.io[/url]]
